newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: COLOMBO STOCKS CONTINUE TO RISE IN JULY - EXCHANGE.
newsitem.headline: COLOMBO STOCKS CONTINUE TO RISE IN JULY - EXCHANGE.

text.p: The Sri Lanka stock market continued its upward trend during the month of July, mostly on the back of good corporate results in the first half of the year and reduced interest rates, the Colombo Stock Exchange (CSE) said.
The all share index rose by 77.8 points to 869.7, or 9.8 percent, in the month of July, the CSE said in its monthy market report seen on Monday.

Turnover fell marginally to 2.07 billion rupees in July from 2.15 billion in the pevious month, but renewed retail buying interest was reflected in the increased number of trades to 24,603 from 17,227 in the previous month, the report said.
Net foreign purchases were 143 million rupees in July.
The report said 1.239 billion rupees were raised from the sale of 51 percent government stake in three plantation companies.
